questions.text: Выбери верную форму: My parents ___ buy a new tent.
questions.explanation: My parents — они (they), поэтому are going to.

options.text: He is going to visit Paris.
He are going to visit Paris.

questions.explanation: С he — is going to + глагол. Частицу to пропускать нельзя.

questions.text: Какие предложения говорят о заранее решённых планах (going to)? (выбери все верные варианты)

options.text: I am going to learn to swim this summer.
They are going to fly to Turkey in July.
We often go to the seaside.

questions.explanation: Планы выражаются через am/is/are going to + глагол. Often go и likes — привычки, Present Simple.

questions.text: ___ your brother going to take his camera?
questions.explanation: Your brother — он (he), вопрос: Is he going to...?

questions.text: We ___ going to stay in a hotel — we have got a tent.
questions.explanation: Отрицание с we: aren't (are not) going to.

questions.text: Впиши форму глагола с going to: I ___ (buy) a map before the trip.
questions.explanation: С I — am going to + глагол: am going to buy.

questions.text: Впиши одно пропущенное слово: Where are you going ___ stay in London?
questions.explanation: Конструкция полностью: am/is/are going to + глагол.

pairs.left: I'm going to swim in the lake.
She isn't going to take her dog.
pairs.right: Она не собирается брать свою собаку.

pairs.left: Are they going to climb the mountain?
We are going to cook on a fire.

questions.explanation: Going to — «собираться что-то сделать»: утверждение, отрицание (isn't) и вопрос (Are...?).

questions.text: Our plan for tomorrow: we ___ visit the old castle.
questions.explanation: С we — are going to; без are конструкция неполная.
